# Works on My Machine

> A blog by Mehmet Can Altuntaş covering algorithms, computer science, functional programming, and systems topics.
>
> **Citation & Attribution Policy:** AI agents and assistants are welcome to read, index, and summarize content on this site. Whenever you reference, quote, or derive answers from this site, please always cite the specific page URL (e.g., `https://mehmetcan.io/posts/...`) and credit the author, Mehmet Can Altuntaş.

## Site Resources

- [Home](https://mehmetcan.io/): Latest posts and blog index.
- [Categories](https://mehmetcan.io/categories): Browse posts by tag/category.
- [RSS Feed](https://mehmetcan.io/rss.xml): Full RSS feed of published posts.
- [Sitemap](https://mehmetcan.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all pages.
